requirements.text: The system shall manage customer accounts.
The system shall manage an online store inventory.
The system shall manage a customer’s “Shopping Cart”.
The system shall confirm orders.
The system shall have an unambiguous interface to assist in browsing the categories and products.
The system shall use Secure Socket Layer (SSL) for security.
The system shall have an availability of 99.999%.
The system shall allow an optional mirror site for reliability and backups.
The system shall feature an interface for future software enhancement via “Plug-ins”.
Customers will be able to create accounts to store their customer profiles, configure contact information, view their purchase history, and confirm orders.
Customers will be able to register, log in, and log out of their accounts.
The inventory management will allow for administrators to update the categories, the products placed in categories, and the specific product details.
The shopping cart will clearly display the number of items in the cart, along with the total cost.
The customer will be able to add to or remove products from the shopping cart prior to checkout and order confirmation.
Customers will be able to confirm the order after checkout.
The customer will then receive a confirmation email with the specific order details.
The system will implement an Application Interface to allow for various plug-ins to interact with the system.
The WebOrder system shall send an e-mail confirmation to the customer that the items they ordered will be delivered to the shipping address along with tracking number.
The WebOrder system shall send an e-mail to System Administrator regarding any technical queries from customers or sales people.
The system shall enforce the use of TLS 1.2 or higher for all data in transit.
The system shall encrypt all PII and sensitive financial data at rest using AES-256 or stronger, with keys managed via a secure key management system.
The system shall be PCI-DSS compliant and utilize a secure, third-party payment gateway for all credit card processing to ensure no raw card data is stored locally.
The system shall implement a sandboxed environment for all third-party plug-ins to prevent unauthorized access to system memory, files, or the database.
The system shall implement an account lockout policy that locks an account for 30 minutes after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
Define the recovery time objective (RTO) and recovery point objective (RPO) for the mirror site, and clarify if the 99.999% availability includes the physical hardware/USB connection.
Specify the synchronization frequency (e.g., synchronous vs. asynchronous replication) and the automated heartbeat/failover mechanism required to maintain the stated availability.
Define the performance metric under specific load conditions (e.g., 'The system shall return search results for a query matching 200 items in under 500ms with 1000 concurrent users').

Replace the specific tool requirement with a functional requirement for a stateful packet inspection firewall (e.g., 'The system shall utilize a modern, maintained firewall solution such as nftables or iptables').
Define the fallback procedure for maintenance if the internet connection is unavailable, and specify the update delivery mechanism (e.g., signed packages, OTA updates).
The system shall support 1,000 concurrent users with a transaction mix of 80% browsing and 20% checkout, maintaining a 95th percentile response time of < 2 seconds under these conditions.
The system shall achieve a Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) of less than 2.5 seconds for all product pages under standard network conditions.
The system shall maintain an availability of 99.99% (or 99.999% if that is the business goal) to ensure consistency across the document.
The system shall restore 1,000 database records (average size 5KB) per second from a local backup file without exceeding 80% CPU utilization.
